inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: A girl wants some cake at a café.
Maya wants some pasta today.
Zara wants some pancakes today.
Ada wants some cake and some juice.
Who wants some cake?
It is Ada!
translations: Bir kız kafede biraz kek istiyor.
Ada biraz kek ve biraz meyve suyu istiyor.

inf.title: What Food Does Mum Have?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: Mum is in the kitchen.
Kerem: Have you got any olives? No, mum hasn't got any olives.
Have you got any cheese? Yes, mum has got some cheese.
Have you got any pasta? No, mum hasn't got any pasta.
Have you got any bread? Yes, mum has got some bread.
What food has mum got?
She has got cheese and bread!
translations: Kerem: Hiç zeytin var mı? Hayır, annenin hiç zeytini yok.
Hiç peynir var mı? Evet, annenin biraz peyniri var.
Hiç makarna var mı? Hayır, annenin hiç makarnası yok.
Hiç ekmek var mı? Evet, annenin biraz ekmeği var.

inf.title: Where Is the Quick Order?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: A boy wants food quickly.
He is not at home.
He is not at a restaurant for a long dinner.
He is not at a café for cake.
He wants a sandwich and some juice.
Mr. Cem helps the boy quickly.
Where is the boy?
He is at a takeaway place!
translations: Uzun bir akşam yemeği için restoranda değil.
Bir sandviç ve biraz meyve suyu istiyor.
Mr. Cem erkeğe hızlı yardım eder.

questions.q: What does the boy want quickly?

inf.title: Who Will Have Pasta?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: A boy looks at the menu at a restaurant.
The boy: I will have some pasta, please.
Leo wants some chicken today.
Kerem will have some pasta today.
Mert wants some soup today.
Who will have some pasta?
It is Kerem!
translations: Bir erkek bir restoranda menüye bakıyor.
Erkek çocuk: Biraz makarna alacağım, lütfen.

questions.correct: I will have some pasta, please.

inf.title: What Does She Say?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: Maya is at home. It is dinner time.
Maya wants the salt.
The answer is not 'Pass me the bread.'
The answer is not 'I am full!'
What does Maya say?
Maya: 'Pass me the salt, please!'

inf.title: What Special Day Is It?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: A family is at a café in Türkiye.
Today is a special day for children.
It is not a religious day.
It is not the 29th of October.
Many children are at cafés today.
The date is the 23rd of April.
What special day is it?
It is Children's Day!
translations: Bugün çocuklar için özel bir gün.
